projectDescription: A browser-based study app for AWS certification exams. Take timed practice quizzes that mirror exam pressure, use untimed guided practice with instant feedback, browse the full question bank, and review AWS services.
features: Practice under exam conditions with timed quizzes.
Use untimed guided practice with instant feedback.
Browse the full AWS certification question bank.
Review AWS services while preparing for certification exams.

projectDescription: An end-to-end agricultural marketplace connecting farmers, agents, and wholesale buyers, with role-based workflows and secure transactions.
features: Developed an MVC-structured marketplace to keep business logic maintainable and testable.
Implemented role-based access control for farmer, agent, and buyer workflows.
Integrated Cloudinary asset management to reduce image latency for mobile users by 40%.
Integrated secure payment processing for transactions between wholesale buyers and farmers.

projectDescription: A multi-role EdTech platform with dedicated dashboards and workflows for administrators, instructors, and students.
features: Built specialized dashboards for administrators, instructors, and students.
Implemented Firebase authentication, session management, and route-level protection for sensitive data.
Used React Query for responsive server-state management.
Added automated notifications for course enrollments and updates.

projectDescription: Easy Bank is a comprehensive, full-stack banking application built with React, Vite, and Firebase. It features secure user authentication (email/password, Google, GitHub), dashboard management with profile and transaction history, credit request application and tracking, and administrative controls for user management, credit processing, and platform oversight.
features: Secure authentication via Firebase (email/password, Google, GitHub); dashboard with profile, account status, and transaction history.
Credit management: apply for and track credit requests; detailed transaction tracking and account activity.
Admin: user management, credit request approval/denial, transaction oversight, and bank status dashboard with real-time metrics.
Responsive, mobile-first design with Tailwind CSS and DaisyUI; protected routes and JWT for API communication.

projectDescription: Trip_Flip is a hotel management web application for exploring and booking hotel services worldwide. Users sign up, book rooms, manage bookings, and share experiences through a user-friendly interface.
features: Executed multi-provider user authentication (email, Google, and GitHub) using secure OAuth 2.0 flows.
Built a full hotel room booking and management system with real-time availability tracking and booking state management.
Developed a post-checkout review and ratings feature, enhancing user trust and engagement.
Integrated protected API routes with JWT-based session management for secure data access.
